description: Standard deterministic offline disposal guidelines and safety instructions for wasteinfoAI 17 canonical waste categories.

rules.preparation_instructions: Tape the electrical terminals with non-conductive electrical tape to prevent short circuits. Store in a dry plastic container.
rules.safety_warnings: Extreme fire and chemical burn hazard. Never place in standard trash or household recycling bins. Do not puncture or expose to heat.

rules.preparation_instructions: Flatten all boxes completely. Remove heavy packing tape, polystyrene, and plastic wrap. Ensure cardboard is clean and free of grease.
rules.safety_warnings: Soiled or greasy cardboard (such as greasy pizza boxes) cannot be recycled with clean paper; compost or dispose in general trash.

rules.preparation_instructions: Empty and rinse bottles and jars thoroughly. Remove metal or plastic caps and lids. Sort by color if local collection requires it.
rules.safety_warnings: Laceration hazard. Handle carefully to prevent breakage. Do not mix lightbulbs, window glass, mirrors, or ceramics with container glass.

rules.preparation_instructions: Remove any rechargeable or disposable batteries if present. Disconnect cables and cords.
rules.safety_warnings: Contains mixed plastics and electronic circuitry. Do not incinerate or place in municipal landfill bins.

rules.preparation_instructions: Rinse food and beverage cans thoroughly. If lids are detached, push them inside the can or crimp the top closed.
rules.safety_warnings: Cut hazard from sharp can edges and lids. Never place pressurized aerosol cans in compaction trucks unless completely emptied.

rules.preparation_instructions: Unplug appliance. Remove glass turntable and wash or place with container glass. Secure the door with tape before transport.
rules.safety_warnings: High-voltage electrical shock hazard. High-voltage capacitors can hold lethal electrical charges even when unplugged. Never attempt disassembly.

rules.preparation_instructions: Back up data and perform a full factory reset. Remove SIM cards and microSD cards. Do not puncture or crush the device.
rules.safety_warnings: Lithium-ion battery puncture and thermal runaway fire hazard. Never place in standard curbside bins.

rules.preparation_instructions: Remove AA/AAA batteries if wireless. Coil cable securely if wired.
rules.safety_warnings: Contains recyclable copper and circuit boards. Do not dispose of in general household waste.

rules.disposal_method: Municipal Composting / Green Organic Waste Bin
rules.preparation_instructions: Collect fruit/vegetable scraps, coffee grounds, eggshells, and food leftovers. Keep free of stickers, twist ties, and plastic wrappings.
rules.safety_warnings: Do not include plastic packaging, pet waste, or synthetic materials. Store in a ventilated caddy to prevent unpleasant odors and pests.

rules.preparation_instructions: Keep paper clean, dry, and flat. Remove metallic spiral bindings, plastic sleeves, and large metal clips.
rules.safety_warnings: Wet or food-contaminated paper (paper towels, tissues, soiled plates) cannot be recycled and should go to organics or landfill.

rules.preparation_instructions: Handle with gloves. Store in a dedicated static-shielded or sealed container away from children and pets.
rules.safety_warnings: Toxic chemical hazard. Printed circuit boards contain heavy metals including lead solder, brominated flame retardants, and nickel. Never burn or crush.

rules.preparation_instructions: Empty contents and rinse clean. Replace caps on bottles after squashing or crushing bottles to save space.
rules.safety_warnings: Check resin identification codes (PETE 1, HDPE 2, PP 5 are widely accepted). Plastic films and bags should go to specialized drop-offs.

rules.preparation_instructions: Remove media (CDs, DVDs, cassettes) and disconnect remote control batteries and power cables.
rules.safety_warnings: Electronic scrap contains reusable copper, aluminum, and plastics. Keep dry until transport.

rules.disposal_method: Electronic Waste Depot / Office Equipment Drop-Off
rules.preparation_instructions: Remove ink cartridges and toner bottles separately for specialized recycling. Secure the scanner lid.
rules.safety_warnings: Toner powder inhalation hazard. Toner dust can cause respiratory irritation if spilled. Handle toner cartridges with care.

rules.preparation_instructions: Keep display screen intact. Protect face of television with cardboard during transport. Disconnect stand and cables.
rules.safety_warnings: Glass implosion/explosion hazard and toxic chemical hazard (mercury cold-cathode backlights in older LCDs, lead in CRT glass). Never break display.

rules.preparation_instructions: Place items in a durable garbage bag. Tie bag securely before placing in the outdoor bin.
rules.safety_warnings: Do not put batteries, hazardous chemicals, hot ashes, or electronic devices into general trash.

rules.disposal_method: Municipal Bulky White Goods Collection / Metal Scrap Facility
rules.preparation_instructions: Disconnect electrical cord and water hoses. Drain all residual water from filter and drum. Tape door shut during transport.
rules.safety_warnings: Heavy lifting and entrapment hazard. Remove door latch or door if storing where children might play before collection.
